findingsFixed.rootCause: simulateSubmitFollowUp: did not check whether self.input was hidden, allowing synthetic follow-up submissions in compact or peek-only states where user interaction is forbidden.
findingsFixed.impact: Violated fail-closed security contract for Magnus Live Activity user input when the panel is in peek presentation.
findingsFixed.change: Added || self.input.hidden to simulateSubmitFollowUp: precondition guard. Recompiled native addon with Apple Clang.

findingsFixed.rootCause: PreBaseGraphEditor listened to onDidChangeViewState with _pushSnapshot() only, without updating _inputType or initializing temporalViewService when graphType switched dynamically.
findingsFixed.impact: Switching from Code Graph to Temporal via commands or Maps sidebar left the editor pane in network mode with uninitialized temporal view state, causing live acceptance failures.
findingsFixed.change: Updated onDidChangeViewState handler to detect graphType transitions, update _inputType, initialize temporalViewService, push temporal state/diff, and push updated snapshot.

findingsFixed.rootCause: PreBaseGraphEditorInput had immutable resource URI and graphType properties despite matches() returning true to enforce single-pane reuse.
findingsFixed.impact: When switching between Code Graph and Temporal, the editor tab label and icon remained stuck on the initial mode without reflecting active view state.
findingsFixed.change: Implemented setGraphType() with reactive _resource mutation and _onDidChangeLabel firing while preserving matches() singleton reuse.

findingsFixed.rootCause: openGraphEditor and openTemporalGraphEditor did not synchronize the active editor input's graphType, and prebase.temporal.open was not registered as a command alias.
findingsFixed.impact: Commands opening Temporal could fail to update existing editor tab titles, and calls to prebase.temporal.open threw command-not-found errors.
findingsFixed.change: Added activeEditor.setGraphType() synchronization to openGraphEditor and openTemporalGraphEditor, and registered prebase.temporal.open alias.

findingsFixed.rootCause: controlFilePath was hardcoded to ~/.vscode-oss-dev/extensions/control.json, and writeControlFile threw unhandled EPERM errors when executed in sandboxed or read-only home directory environments.
findingsFixed.impact: PreBase launches failed during pre-launch built-in extension synchronization under terminal sandbox or containerized execution.
findingsFixed.change: Added VSCODE_EXTENSIONS_CONTROL_PATH environment override and wrapped writeControlFile in a safe try/catch block matching readControlFile resilience.

findingsFixed.rootCause: findGraphFrame only inspected top-level page.frames() and matched on nonexistent 'graph-editor' URL substrings, failing to discover #netCanvas inside nested iframe trees.
findingsFixed.impact: Live acceptance tests for visual recovery and Code Graph frames reported false-negative timeouts.
findingsFixed.change: Expanded findGraphFrame to search childFrames() and nested iframe contentFrames, reliably locating the active canvas frame.

findingsRejected.why: Strict equality causes VS Code to open separate editor panes for Network and Temporal, creating duplicate WebGL/Canvas contexts and OOPIF renderers that increase process count during active soak. Single-pane reuse with dynamic setGraphType is the correct Ponytail architecture.
Explicitly forbidden by persistent user instructions. The active-soak test must run full duration without threshold dilution.
